mainEntity.name: How do I book a minicab from Angel N1 to Heathrow Airport?

acceptedAnswer.text: Book online through our secure platform, call our team directly, or complete a reservation in minutes. All Angel N1 bookings receive instant confirmation with driver details and a guaranteed fixed price.

mainEntity.name: How far is Angel N1 from Heathrow Airport?

acceptedAnswer.text: Angel N1 is approximately 16 miles (26 km) from Heathrow Airport via the A501 westbound connecting through Marylebone Road and then the A40 westbound towards Heathrow. Journey times typically range from 40 to 60 minutes depending on traffic conditions along the A501 corridor and the A40 westbound approach.

mainEntity.name: What is the minicab fare from Angel N1 to Heathrow?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our Angel N1 to Heathrow saloon fare starts from £55 with a fully fixed price. The airport pickup fare is slightly higher at £60 to include terminal waiting and parking allowances.

mainEntity.name: Is Meet and Greet available at Heathrow for Angel N1 passengers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our complimentary Meet & Greet service is available at all four Heathrow terminals. Your chauffeur waits in the arrivals hall with a personalised name board and assists with luggage before your transfer to Angel N1.

mainEntity.name: Is LTR Minicab available 24 hours a day from Angel N1?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our Angel N1 minicab service operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week including public holidays, with no out-of-hours surcharges applied to any booking.

mainEntity.name: Is LTR Minicab an affordable Heathrow transfer from Angel N1?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. LTR Minicab provides competitive fixed-price Heathrow transfers from Angel N1 from £55 for a Saloon. All fares are locked in at booking with no surge pricing, meter additions, or hidden charges.

mainEntity.name: Which airports can I travel to from Angel N1?

acceptedAnswer.text: We operate direct transfers from Angel N1 to Heathrow, Gatwick, Stansted, Luton, London City, and Southend Airport with fixed fares and professional licensed chauffeurs.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer group transfers from Angel N1?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We provide MPV 5, MPV 6, MPV 7, and MPV 8 vehicles for families and groups travelling from Angel N1 to airports, hotels, and UK destinations.

mainEntity.name: Do you cover Upper Street, Chapel Market, and all streets within Angel N1?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We cover all streets and addresses within Angel N1 including Upper Street, Liverpool Road, Pentonville Road, City Road, Islington Green, Camden Passage, Chapel Market, Colebrooke Row, Canonbury Lane, and all surrounding residential streets and mews throughout the Angel and Islington area.

mainEntity.name: Is the Angel N1 minicab service available on weekends and bank holidays?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our Angel N1 minicab service runs every day of the year including weekends and all UK bank holidays at no additional cost.
